notes: A078537.A078537_conj: every M with M i j = 0 (i<j), M i 0 = 1, M^4 shifted = M has row-n sum = number of Nat.Partition (4^n) into powers of 4. Key: [M^s](n,k) = t(n-k, s 4^k - 1) from the convolution identity sum_j t(m-j, A q^j - 1) t(j,b) = t(m, A+b). Also proves A078536's conjectured formula (A078536_formula) and existence (A078536_exists). Same proof works for any q (A078121, A078122).
